createaerophysicsgantry.belt_wheel.axis_: Belt wheels must share the same rotation axis.
createaerophysicsgantry.belt_wheel.dista: Belt wheel distance is out of range (max 64 blocks).
createaerophysicsgantry.belt_wheel.link_: Belt wheel selected. Right-click another belt wheel with the belt connector to link.
The selected belt wheel is no longer available.
Cannot link a belt wheel to itself.
createaerophysicsgantry.belt_wheel.not_s: Belt wheels must be in a straight line.
createaerophysicsgantry.ponder.belt_whee: Belt Wheels link together using a Mechanical Belt.
Right-Clicking two Belt Wheels with a belt item will connect them together
Belt Wheels can link together through blocks
You can unlink two belt wheels with Shears on either Belt Wheel
You cannot connect two Belt Wheels that do not have the same rotation axis
They also must be aligned in order to connect them
Belt Wheels can also link across different Simulated Contraptions.
When one side is given rotation...
...the other side will receive that same rotation.
You can then use that rotation through the shaft on either end...
createaerophysicsgantry.ponder.physics_g: Physics Gantry Carriages can mount to and slide along only Physics Gantry Shafts
Physics Gantry Carriages will only move while it is a Simulated Contraption, even if the shaft is rotating.
Make the carriage a Simulated Contraption by right clicking it, at which it will begin moving.
Just like regular Gantries, Physics Gantry setups can move attached blocks.
Either Honey Glue or Super Glue can be used to move larger structures.
Redstone-powered physics gantry shafts stop moving their carriages
Because Physics Gantry Carriages are Simulated Contraptions, they will not disassemble when stopping between blocks.
Physics Gantry Shafts form the basis of a physics gantry setup. Attached Carriages will move along them.
Physics Gantry Carriages will only move while it is a Simulated Contraption, even if the shaft is rotating.
Make the carriage a Simulated Contraption by right clicking it, at which it will begin moving.
